name: lib/io
description: Reads and writes text through standard streams and open files.
readme: Reads and writes text through standard streams and open files.
Import this module with use io.

files.content:
-- Reads and writes text through standard streams and open files.
public define Stream as opaque.
public use "io" function input giving pointer to Stream.
public use "io" function output giving pointer to Stream.
public use "io" function report giving pointer to Stream.
public use "io" function read(stream pointer to Stream, size unsigned) giving failable text.
public use "io" function line(stream pointer to Stream) giving failable text.
public use "io" function write(stream pointer to Stream, content text) giving failable nothing.
public use "io" function close(stream pointer to Stream) giving failable nothing.
public function display(content text) giving nothing {
  write(output, content) fallback nothing.
}
public function diagnose(content text) giving nothing {
  write(report, content) fallback nothing.
}
